query: /* mysql */ update t_scan set status = ?, findings_count = ?, new_issues_count = ?, resolved_issues_count = ?, duration_ms = ?, sbom = coalesce(?, sbom), project_type = case when ? then ? else project_type end, version = case when ? then ? else version end, error = ?, plugin_steps = ?, detected_languages = ?, examined_types = coalesce(?, examined_types), claimed_by = null, claimed_at = null, lease_expires_at = null where id = ?
